answer: The best sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: influence equals account age times honest epochs, so a fresh identity starts near zero and gains weight only by surviving verifiable interactions over real time. Like a nebula condensing into a star, reputation forms gradually; each honest epoch is an inlet feeding the score. An attacker spawning thousands of opal-bright new accounts gains almost nothing, since influence cannot be bought instantly and every identity must wait out real calendar time, making mass fakery economically pointless.
